reason: The parent question conflates (1) what each inventoried document establishes and (2) which document governs on disagreement. Workspace text supports mechanically partitionable answers by document_kind and incorporation pattern: issued permits self-define governing Parts; appendices are incorporated by cross-reference; supporting package documents frame draft/proposed rationale and defer limitations. Filename kind is not hierarchy. A one-size parent admission would over-generalize or leave minor_modification authority unresolved. Children supersede the coarse parent.
